# Test Archives for GoUnRAR

Generated by `scripts/gen_test_archives.sh` using RAR 7.20.

Re-run that script to regenerate. **Do not edit these files by hand.**

## Archives

| File | Format | Notes |
|------|--------|-------|
| `single_rar5.rar` | RAR5 | Two text files + one nested in `subdir/` |
| `compressed_rar5.rar` | RAR5 (`-m3`) | 6000 deterministic text lines, the only compressed member here; drives the block decoder's worker path |
| `multi_new.part01-10.rar` | RAR5 multi-volume | 8 KiB of random data split into 1 KiB volumes |
| `two_members.part1-6.rar` | RAR5 multi-volume, stored | `first.txt` (35 bytes) ends in volume 1; `second.txt` (200 lines of `second member line NNNN`) spans volumes 1-6 |
| `password_rar5.rar` | RAR5 | Password: `testpass` |
| `encrypted_header.rar` | RAR5 | Header-encrypted, password: `testpass` |
| `corrupt.rar` | RAR5 (damaged) | Bytes overwritten at offset 20 |
| `with_dirs.rar` | RAR5 | Contains directory entries |
| `rar5_link_symlink.rar` | RAR5 | `real.txt` and `link.txt` -> `real.txt` (copied from rarengine testdata) |
| `rar5_link_hard.rar` | RAR5 | `orig.txt` and hard link `hard.txt` -> `orig.txt` (copied from rarengine testdata) |
| `rar5_link_solid.rar` | RAR5 solid | `a.txt`, symlink `mid.lnk` -> `a.txt`, `c.txt` back-referencing `a.txt` (copied from rarengine testdata) |
| `rar5_link_escape.rar` | RAR5 | `real.txt`, symlink `evil.lnk` -> `../../etc/passwd`, `after.txt` |
| `rar5_link_filecopy.rar` | RAR5 | `orig.txt` and file reference `copy.txt` -> `orig.txt` (`rar a -ma5 -oi:1 -m0`, identical contents) |
| `flat_collide.rar`, `flat_collide.7z` | RAR5, 7z | `a/f.txt`=`one` and `b/f.txt`=`two`, which flatten to one name |
| `flat_dir_file.rar`, `flat_dir_file.7z` | RAR5, 7z | File `a/x`=`file` and directory `b/x` holding `b/x/y`=`y`; RAR stores the file before the directory, 7z the directories first |

## Limitations

RAR 7.x removed `-ma4` so RAR4 (v3 compression) archives cannot be generated.
If RAR4 test fixtures are needed, generate them with an older `rar` binary and
commit manually.
